newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, seen rising further.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, seen rising further.

text.p: Portuguese shares closed the day up 1.32 percent and dealers said they expected the shares to rise further, buoyed by a healthy economy and strong dollar.
Wednesday's unsteady opening in New York failed to dent the positive performance in Lisbon, dealers said.

Telecommunications dominated activity, notably shares in Portugal Telecom and mobile phone operator Telecel PT ended the day up 90 escudos to 4,935 escudos in volume of 522,140 shares and Telecel hit a record high of 11,689 escudos before easing back to close at 11,352 escudos, up 762, in volume of 195,636 shares.
